posts.title: AI: The Devil on My Shoulder
posts.description: This is meant to be a sort of retrospective, both in my view and use of AI. I have wanted to write down my thoughts and experience with it for a while, mostly for my own sake. It's also my first time really writing much (that isn't strictly documentation) since school. It is very much a train of thought thing and not very polished, read at your own peril.
